game.summary: Restored match-online-001's snapshot (2a47271, features/ excluded; diff --stat against it was empty before edits). Fixes: (1) new tests/integration/endingsHarness.test.ts, in the quiet harness group via vitest.config.ts: a quitter's Moon goes to a cache, the host and guest fight a mirrored double KO (a settled draw), the host collects a Sun, claims the cached Moon and wins by a claim; it asserts every player's exact results line, including duelsDrawn and cachesClaimed. All nine columns are now non-zero in some ending. (2) The theft-choice key handler is extracted into hud.ts theftChooser, and main.ts wires it; a unit test sends repeat:true keydowns during a choice window and gets exactly one choose-theft. (3) Flow HUD unit test asserts the reset text for moved, released, duel, disconnected, ineligible and deadline; docs/architecture.md says why the room can't produce ineligible. (4) Deleted 96 room branches and 51 UI branches one at a time on scratch copies and ran the relevant tests. For survivors I added tests: lobby (admission refusal via onJoin spy, listing-lag refusal in the room, malformed and rate-limited starts, roster), claim (waiting status, rival's claimHeld, cleared reset reason), reveals (route reactivated on a restored set), endings (cancelled duel, duel cancelled by the match end, quitter's rubbing in the theft window, no reveal on the deadline tick, pause stops the clock), ledgerSeed (duel and intel seeds, test hooks off), rubbingsExpiry (expiry leaves the flow), flowHud (phase names, empty carrier report, drawn column, circle with no route, startRefusalLine), full-match e2e (the rival in sight sees data-claiming and the warning). Room changes: an intelState getter for tests only; main.ts now uses the extracted theftChooser and startRefusalLine helpers. Checks run on the final code: npm ci; typecheck ok; test:unit 1235 passed; test:integration 98 passed in 171.6 s (budget 300 s; the new harness file takes 18.8 s); build ok with smoke; the full playwright suite passed 10/10 with a JSON report, and check-report printed ok for all 9 scenarios.
open_assumptions: Branches that no test can reach are left as they are and listed as unreachable, not tested: the room's join-refused handler (the match module processes joins before starts, and the room refuses joins after the lobby), the start from a session that isn't a ledger player, and the unknown-id filters before stepMatch (duel-ended, match-ended winner, playerId reports and reportAccomplishments' known filter). Also the left-player skip in stepClaim: a left player's ship is removed in the same call.
Two initialisations in startControl (reportedGold and lastLocations) survive deletion because they are equivalent: nothing moves or changes gold before the first in-play tick.
The listing-lag test simulates the admission/room race by calling room.setMatchmaking directly after the start.
